audit.why: The chart (Gwen 1-2, even at 3, Yi from 4 through first item, Gwen at 2+) matches every why and both spikes, and matches the 42.74% win rate — this is a losing lane that only turns on scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Highlander is named as the thing that owns levels 6 through first item with no cooldown or duration mechanic attached, and Alpha Strike likewise.
audit.why: Highlander is a flat 85s at every rank and its duration EXTENDS on kills and assists, and it passively refunds his other cooldowns on a takedown — that is why one kill snowballs the whole mid-game. Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 but basic attacks reduce it, and Meditate is a flat 10s.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the takedown-extension added to the mid-game spike and whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions are absent: Highlander makes him immune to slows, Wuju Style adds TRUE damage to his autos, and Alpha Strike makes him untargetable.
audit.why: Needlework is Gwen's only kiting tool and it is a slow — during Highlander it does literally nothing to his movement, which is the real reason he 'chases you through your dashes'. Wuju Style (E, flat 14s) means armour is the wrong buy against him. Alpha Strike makes him untargetable for its duration, so damage and Needlework needles thrown at the cast are wasted, and his basic attacks pull that 20-second cooldown down fast. Meditate (W, flat 10s) heals and reduces damage, so Grievous Wounds has to be on him before he channels.
audit.corrected: All four stated across the mid-game spike, whys and the mid/late paragraphs.

edits.after: Highlander (85s) is slow-immune — Needlework cannot kite it. Farm safe.

edits.after: Levels 4-5 are Yi's: Wuju Style puts TRUE damage on his autos, so armour will not save your trades.

edits.after: Level 6 is his — Highlander is slow-immune, so Needlework cannot kite the run-down.

edits.before: First item stays Yi: he shreds through your passive sustain before your scaling arrives.
edits.after: First item stays Yi: Meditate (W) heals through your chip unless Grievous is already on him.

edits.before: Levels 6 through first item are the survival chapter — Highlander chases through your dashes and his shred beats your sustain, so treat every open wave as a trap. Farm with Q from max range, hold W strictly for his commit, and pad your build with HP where you can. Every minion collected here is a brick in the wall he must climb later.
edits.after: Levels 6 through first item are the survival chapter — Highlander is a flat 85s, it makes him immune to slows so Needlework cannot kite him, and every takedown extends it. Farm with Q from max range, hold W strictly for his commit, and get Grievous up before he channels Meditate. Every minion here is a brick in the wall he must climb.

edits.before: At two items the duel is finally, permanently yours: Hallowed Mist blanks his all-in from the outside, and your stacked on-hit shred out-DPSes him inside the fight he starts. Side-lane bravely — bait his engage into mist, saw him down, and remind him the scaling matchup was never actually his. In teamfights, mist yourself and shred whoever dives.
edits.after: At two items the duel is permanently yours: Hallowed Mist blanks his all-in from outside, and your on-hit shred out-DPSes him in the fight he starts. Do not dump damage into Alpha Strike — he is untargetable for it, and his autos drag that 20-second cooldown down. Bait the engage into mist, saw him down, and mist yourself in teamfights to shred whoever dives.
